Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Liverpool hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 3, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 18 Liverpool hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 5, trivago DEALS at 3, Agoda at 1, dealbase.com at 1, Radissonhotels.com at 1, Super.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Liverpool rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Liverpool hotels

At the 15 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 22% ($29 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 18% at Malacuna Liverpool to 23% at ibis Liverpool Centre Albert Dock - Liverpool One. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
